findings.message: The proposed revision removes libgomp1_libs from runtime-libraries stage-packages, but the service command still uses --engine parallel which requires libgomp.so.1. The supplied evidence confirms libgomp1_libs is the sole source of this library in the rootfs. Removal will cause startup failure with an unresolved library error. Restore libgomp1_libs or confirm intentional removal with evidence of an alternative mechanism.

summary: Source bump from commit 000000000000000000000000000000000000000e to 000000000000000000000000000000000000000f in canonical/demo-rock. Recipe removes libgomp1_libs package slice, a mandatory runtime dependency for the configured service engine.
